method: Manual review under writing-naturalness.md, checked against local source, GitHub PR metadata and workflow-run records, then slop_check.py.
score_reason: The report uses exact files, SHAs, run IDs, and explicit limits. Some technical sentences are dense, but the PR status is separated into short bullets.
confidence_reason: The factual statements were checked in local source or current PR and run records. The style judgment is a self-review and is not calibrated.

examples.cue: The paragraph names what remains unverified and what the edit does not establish.
examples.impact: Readers can separate the documentation check from parity, calibration, and release claims.
examples.quote: The citation checker still skips 17 items it cannot resolve precisely.

science_gate_reason: This report records a documentation reconciliation, not a new scientific result.
facts_gate_reason: The new route descriptions, status counts, PR head, and exact workflow status were compared with their source records.
references_gate_reason: Local source/test files and cited PR/workflow records were checked; unresolved historical capability citations are stated as a residual.
calibration_status: No style controls were used; this is an uncalibrated editorial judgment.
